verdict: REJECTED, and not marginally: c is 40x below break-even. The competition-season shift is NOT heterogeneous along the buyer margin in any way our ensemble misses. The ensemble is already well calibrated along this direction.
what_it_rules_out: The hypothesis that our 29 bases share a common seasonal blind spot with a p*(1-p) signature. Since the season is known to act through P(y>0) rather than basket size, the buyer margin was the single most mechanically-motivated shape for such a blind spot. Its absence is strong evidence that no simple reweighting of the existing prediction along a shift-shaped direction is available.
consistency_with_earlier_direction_probe: Earlier direction probes were all below the 0.0114 break-even. This probe is an order of magnitude smaller still.
no_follow_up_directions: The preregistered key required |c| >= 0.0114 to justify extending to a set of shift-shaped directions. It failed by 40x, so the axis is closed with no further probes.
